import re
import sys
import zipfile

path = sys.argv[1]

with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    entries = {i.filename: (i, z.read(i.filename)) for i in z.infolist()}

sheet = entries["xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"][1].decode("utf-8")
styles = entries["xl/styles.xml"][1].decode("utf-8")

# 1) Extend dimension
sheet = sheet.replace('<dimension ref="A1:G10"/>', '<dimension ref="A1:H10"/>')

# 2) Add column H definition after column G
sheet = sheet.replace(
    '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/>',
    '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/>'
    '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="8" max="8"/>',
)

# 3) Add H cells per row (header, data, total)
def row_repl(m):
    r = int(m.group(1))
    row_xml = m.group(2)
    if r == 1:
        cell = '<c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin %</t></is></c>'
    elif r == 10:
        cell = '<c r="H10" s="4"><f>G10/E10</f><v></v></c>'
    else:
        cell = f'<c r="H{r}" s="3"><f>G{r}/E{r}</f><v></v></c>'
    return f'<row r="{r}">' + row_xml + cell + '</row>'

sheet = re.sub(r'<row r="(\d+)">(.*?)</row>', row_repl, sheet, flags=re.S)

# 4) Percent number format in styles
styles = styles.replace(
    '<numFmts count="0"/>',
    '<numFmts count="1"><numFmt numFmtId="164" formatCode="0.0%"/></numFmts>',
)
styles = styles.replace(
    '<cellXfs count="3">',
    '<cellXfs count="5">',
)
styles = styles.replace(
    '</cellXfs>',
    '<xf numFmtId="164" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/>'
    '<xf numFmtId="164" fontId="1" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/>'
    '</cellXfs>',
    1,
)

entries["xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"] = (entries["xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"][0], sheet.encode("utf-8"))
entries["xl/styles.xml"] = (entries["xl/styles.xml"][0], styles.encode("utf-8"))

with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    for info, data in entries.values():
        z.writestr(info, data)

print("done")
